mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflationary pressure, which leads to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where CPIAUCSL shows a month-over-month increase, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 3.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where UNRATE > 3.5, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a contraction in the housing sector and tighter financial conditions, which together depress corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST change * FEDFUNDS change) does not have a negative coefficient in a regression of 20-day returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months and CPIAUCSL > 300), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risks and reduced corporate investment.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising for 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 300
evidence_refs: fact:CPIAUCSL at 301.648 (above 300) and FEDFUNDS at 4.57% (rising from 4.0% in Dec 2022)
failure_condition: In periods where the regime condition (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 months and CPIAUCSL>300) is met, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where INDPRO shows a month-over-month decline, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units signals weak residential construction, which reduces economic growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where HOUST < 1300, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS change * UNRATE change) does not have a negative coefficient in a regression of 20-day returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% (as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1) indicates strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:GDPC1 at 20187.495 (Oct 2022) for Q4 2022 (which was 2.6% YoY growth)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 50% of quarters where GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
